# HIST 315: The French Revolution & Modernity
Fall 2026
Professor: Dr. Genevieve Moreau
Email: gmoreau@university.edu

## Course Requirements
- Primary Source Analyses (3): 30%
- Midterm Essay: 25%
- Research Paper: 35%
- Seminar Participation: 10%

## Weekly Modules and Seminars

- Module 1 (Aug 31 - Sep 4): Introduction to the Old Regime; Syllabus Agreement due Sep 2 at midnight; Diagnostic Essay due Sep 4 by 5:00 PM
- Session IV (Sep 21): Read Sieyès, “What is the Third Estate?”; Primary Source Analysis #1 due in class
- Session VII (Oct 12): Read Rousseau, “The Social Contract”; Primary Source Analysis #2 due by noon via Canvas
- Session IX (Oct 26): Midterm Essay due Oct 26 at 11:59pm EST (submit to Canvas)
- Session XII (Nov 16): Read Robespierre, “On the Principles of Political Morality”; Primary Source Analysis #3 due in class
- Session XIV (Nov 30): Research Paper Draft due Nov 30 @ 5p (bring 2 hard copies to seminar)
- Final Term: Research Paper Final Submission due Dec 14, 2026 by midnight
